features: 30 Watts of Power: With 30 watts of power, FINGERS 2Mic-GrooveBox-K30 Portable Speaker can deliver a robust and powerful sound that can make your house party feel like a rock concert.

2 Microphones: Comes with two wireless microphones, which is great for duets and singing along with a partner. Crafted with precision, the shock-mount mechanism in the microphones eliminates unwanted noise and wind interference, delivering crystal-clear audio perfection.
Uni-Directional U-Band (UHF 693 MHz): The microphones operate at the UHF 693MHz frequency, for crystal-clear vocals and zero interference within a 30-meter transmission distance.

Versatile Features of Mic: Explore VIP Function/Mic Priority, Vocal Silence, Echo Control, and entertaining voice changeovers (Female to Male, Male to Female, Doll Voice, Magic Voice, Standard Mic) for a customizable audio experience.

6.5-hour Playback: This speaker comes with a powerful battery that can keep the party going for up to 6.5 hours, even at maximum volume. Whether you're playing loud beats or soothing melodies, it ensures uninterrupted entertainment.
Record your moments: You can record and play your favourite jokes, announcements, or messages for up to 140 seconds, adding a personal touch to your gatherings.
Grab and Go: Featuring an elegant leather handle, take the party anywhere, indoors or outdoors, with ease
Full Function Control: This portable speaker & mic duo offers seamless switching between various modes, including Bluetooth, FM Radio, MicroSD, and USB. And stay informed with the Digital Display.

Versatile Companion for Every Occasion: From Karaoke Nights and Antakshari Challenges to Soulful Bhajan Sessions, Festival Get-Togethers, Garden, Terrace, Picnic, and Campfire Gatherings, Memorable House Parties, Energized Conference Rooms, Active Sports Events, to Engaging Fitness & Group Workouts – this portable speaker sets the perfect atmosphere for every occasion.
